requirement: PT window open, maximized, focused, uninterrupted

configs.HQ_Router:
hostname HQ_Router
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption
!
interface s0/0/0
 description to-BR_Router
 ip address 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.252
 clock rate 64000
 no shutdown
exit
interface g0/0
 description to-HQ_Switch
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
exit
interface g0/0
 ip helper-address 192.168.1.101
exit
aaa new-model
tacacs-server host 192.168.1.100
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local
aaa authorization exec default group tacacs+ local
line vty 0 4
 login authentication default
 transport input telnet
exit
time-range OFFICE_HOURS
 periodic weekdays 08:00 to 17:00
exit
ip access-list standard VTY_MANAGER_ONLY
 permit host 192.168.1.50 time-range OFFICE_HOURS
 deny any
exit
line vty 0 4
 access-class VTY_MANAGER_ONLY in
exit
! Site-to-site IPSec
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encr aes
 hash sha
 authentication pre-share
 group 5
exit
! IPSec pre-shared key not supplied; tunnel is intentionally incomplete
crypto ipsec transform-set SITE_VPN_SET esp-aes esp-sha-hmac
exit
ip access-list extended SITE_VPN_TRAFFIC
 permit ip 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.2.0 0.0.0.255
exit
ip route 192.168.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.1.1.2
end
write memory
configs.BR_Router:
hostname BR_Router
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption
!
interface s0/0/0
 description to-HQ_Router
 ip address 10.1.1.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
exit
interface g0/0
 description to-BR_Switch
 ip address 192.168.2.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
exit
interface g0/0
 ip helper-address 192.168.1.101
exit
ip access-list extended BRANCH_TO_HQ
 permit tcp 192.168.2.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.1.102 eq 80
 deny ip 192.168.2.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.1.100
 permit ip any any
exit
interface s0/0/0
 ip access-group BRANCH_TO_HQ out
exit
! Site-to-site IPSec
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encr aes
 hash sha
 authentication pre-share
 group 5
exit
! IPSec pre-shared key not supplied; tunnel is intentionally incomplete
crypto ipsec transform-set SITE_VPN_SET esp-aes esp-sha-hmac
exit
ip access-list extended SITE_VPN_TRAFFIC
 permit ip 192.168.2.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255
exit
ip route 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0 10.1.1.1
end
write memory
configs.HQ_Switch:
hostname HQ_Switch
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption
!
! Port security: one MAC per user port, shutdown on violation
interface range f0/2 - 24
 switchport mode access
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security maximum 1
 switchport port-security violation shutdown
 ip dhcp snooping limit rate 10
exit
! DHCP snooping; the router uplink is trusted
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan 1
interface f0/1
 ip dhcp snooping trust
exit
end
write memory
